title: Clozapine after the REMS removal: labeling, the new Medication Guide and ANC monitoring
rule_summary: FDA's Drug Safety Communication announcing the removal of the Clozapine REMS, effective June 13, 2025, states that the removed REMS required enrollment of prescribers, pharmacies, and patients in a restricted distribution program and reporting of the absolute neutrophil count (ANC); that as a result of the removal prescribers, pharmacies, and patients are no longer required to participate in the REMS program and report patients' ANC results to the REMS in order for clozapine to be dispensed; that pharmacies do not need to be enrolled in the REMS to order clozapine from wholesaler distributors and pharmacists do not need to verify patient eligibility, including ANC monitoring, before dispensing clozapine to patients; that severe neutropenia remains a serious, potentially fatal risk and information about it is in the prescribing information for all clozapine medicines, including in a Boxed Warning and a new Medication Guide; that FDA recommends that prescribers monitor patients' ANC according to the monitoring frequencies described in the prescribing information; and that prescribers should continue to monitor ANC before starting clozapine and during treatment and counsel patients about the risk of severe neutropenia.
exam_relevance: Separates what the REMS removal ended for pharmacies, enrollment to order and eligibility verification before dispensing, from what the clozapine labeling still carries, including a Boxed Warning and a Medication Guide.

authority.name: FDA Drug Safety Communication: FDA removes risk evaluation and mitigation strategy (REMS) program for the antipsychotic drug clozapine
authority.section: What Is FDA Announcing?; What Is FDA Doing?; What Should Health Care Professionals Do?

common_confusions: Treating the removal of the REMS as the removal of the neutropenia warning; the prescribing information carries a Boxed Warning and a new Medication Guide.

Reading FDA's ANC-monitoring recommendation as a pharmacy dispensing gate; FDA addresses the recommendation to prescribers and states that pharmacists do not need to verify patient eligibility, including ANC monitoring, before dispensing.
Assuming a pharmacy still needs REMS enrollment to buy clozapine; FDA states that pharmacies do not need to be enrolled in the REMS to order clozapine from wholesaler distributors.
verification_notes: Read the FDA Drug Safety Communication page on 2026-09-14 (communication dated 08-27-2025; page content current as of 04/03/2026). Clozapine no longer appears among the approved REMS listed on REMS@FDA, and the CLOZARIL tablet labeling on DailyMed (revised 6/2025) includes a Medication Guide and a boxed warning.
